teaser:open.text: Hypercomb. A new way to be.

teaser:hive.text: Your work lives on a grid of hexagons, on your own machine. Click a tile and you travel into it.

teaser:presence.text: There is no server and no account. It runs in your browser, and nothing leaves until you say so.

teaser:signature.text: Everything has one kind of name: a signature, computed from the content itself. Same content, same name, on every machine. You verify instead of trusting.

teaser:open-source.text: It is open source, and every feature is a signed module — so a fork is something you can prove.

teaser:close.text: Type a name, press Enter, and you have a hive. Hypercomb — the hive is yours.
